'''Medical officers''' were specialized [[operative]]s of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with medical training. Each [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' [[Squad/Legends|squad]] had a medical officer or [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] assigned to it.<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>
